text:
Lydia: heads-up — Maple POC reporting erratic first-token latency after a short stress run. p50 usually ~160ms, now 600-1.1s intermittently.
Marco: hosted or dedicated? any special flags?
Lydia: hosted trial. They turned on prefill per quickstart and used a small batch window to speed demos.
Taina: diag-bot, runtime info?
diag-bot: runtime v2.13.x in us-west-2 deployed 08:40 PT. No infra alerts.
Marco: what's their prefill config + concurrency? small windows + concurrency = classic KV thrash.
Lydia: posted by customer: `prefill: true, prefill_batch_window_ms: 200, max_prefill_tokens: 512`, concurrency ~12, model `redwood-2-8b-quant`.
Kai: any 429s observed?
Lydia: brief 429 spike during the burst, then latency spikes.
Marco: ask for session diag: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/diag/session/<sid>?fields=queue,kvcache,rate`
Lydia: customer returned: `queue_wait_ms=378, kvcache_miss=true, backend_ms=92, x-ratelimit-remaining=68`.
Taina: kvcache_miss=true + queue_wait high = prefill write/read race across shards.
Marco: quick mitigations: 1) disable prefill temporarily to verify baseline, 2) bump `prefill_batch_window_ms` to 800-1200ms, 3) enable `prefill_strict_sequencing` if needed.
Lydia: customer worried about demo SLA (p50 <300ms) and asked if we can credit affected POC time.
sales-ops: provisional goodwill credit (one hosted day) is available if instability persists after our guided fix + 24h monitor. Need deal owner approval.
Marco: short test plan: A) disable prefill and replay the same load for 3-5m, B) if p50 recovers, re-enable with `prefill_batch_window_ms=1000` and watch KV hit-rate + per-shard queue_wait_ms.
Lydia: customer did quick disable -> p50 ~210ms, no 429s in 5m.
Taina: confirms prefill interaction. We'll schedule controlled re-enable TOM 09:00 PT with infra watching shard queues.
Marco: include this API patch in the customer email to apply for re-enable:
```
PATCH /v1/projects/<proj>/settings
{ "prefill": { "enabled": true, "prefill_batch_window_ms": 1000, "prefill_strict_sequencing": false } }
```
Lydia: also ask them to include `x-ratelimit-*` headers if they see errors and paste diag output.
Kai: follow-ups: ["monitor kvcache hit-rate during re-enable","capture per-shard queue_wait_ms","verify no 429s and note x-ratelimit header values","rollback plan to disable prefill quickly"]
Marco: thanks — I'll join the 09:00 PT call. Lydia, please update the POC ticket with the plan and credit pledge wording. :thumbsup:
